newsitem.title: FRANCE: Dollar in credible zone - Camdessus.
newsitem.headline: Dollar in credible zone - Camdessus.

text.p: IMF managing director Michel Camdessus said on Tuesday that the dollar was in a credible zone against European currencies and the yen.
He had been asked whether he was worried about the recent sharp rise in the U.S. currency.
He said the dollar was only "a few centimes" above its recent levels and the rise over the last year was a correction.
"We are in a credible zone for the dollar against European currencies and against the yen," he told reporters after meeting French President Jacques Chirac.
Camdessus said he had discussed last month's U.S. quarter-point interest rate rise with Chirac.
"I told him that I think the measures taken were rather reassuring," he said.
He said that American monetary policy was contributing toward stability.
He said he had no comment when asked about the likelihood of further U.S. interest rate rises.
